title: zcmc13
description: A simple modpack focusing mainly on aesthetics and optimization, with a few quality-of-life improvements.
body:
You can never go wrong with Minecraft's vanilla look, but I wanted to find a look that gave a more fun and interesting approach, while still keeping a very close resemblance to that. 

With that in mind, I found a few resource packs like [Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations), [Grass+](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/grass+), and [Simple Grass Flowers](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/simple-grass-flowers) that do not add any additional items to the game, (just tweak the vanilla appearances). I found mods like [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [More Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/moreculling),  [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling) to use for optimization, and quality-of-life mods like [Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks) and [Shulker Box Tooltip](https://modrinth.com/mod/shulkerboxtooltip). I then added some mods like [Camera Utils](https://modrinth.com/mod/camera-utils) and [ReplayMod ](https://modrinth.com/mod/replaymod) to help with the aspect of recording.

## **_Where to use it!_**
I believe this modpack to be client-side only, for I have not tested it anywhere except my single player world, but it may be supported on servers as well. Always be sure to check with your servers moderators to see what mods they allow you to use.

## **_!DISCLAIMER!_**
* I do not own nor have I made any of the mods in this modpack. 

* If there are any issues please refer to the respective mods issues page/s.
